desc:
RAGDOLL SWORD BATTLES

Swing it like you mean it. Every blade runs on real physics: where you hit, how hard you swing and what they're wearing decide what happens. Cut through armour, take off a limb, or send someone flying off the edge of the arena.

- Free-for-all, team battles and wild rounds, with a map vote every match
- Longswords, axes, war hammers, the red-hot 1000 Degree Sword and the ultra-rare Colossal Sword
- Armour that really stops blades, from leather to full plate
- Abilities: Grappling Hook, Pocket Sand, Iron Skin, Puppet Master and more
- Bare-knuckle brawling with charged haymakers
- 1v1 duel arenas in the lobby
- Open crates, level up and unlock tabards and trails
- Play on PC, mobile, console and VR

Join the group for FREE coins at the lobby pad!
Like and favourite to support the game.
